question:
The bar graph shows the candidates recruited in the 2 different banks M and N in different years. What is the average number of candidates in bank N in all the years together? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/850de03c7f3bfe1151a24606a60605ab25afbbe3038f4f536f53b018ff0bef69.png]
solution:
**Concept used:**

Average = Total/number of observasion

**Calculation:**

The total number of candidates in bank N is

900 + 810 + 760 + 890 = 3360

Average is,

3360 ÷ 4 = 840

**The average number of candidates in bank N in all the years together is 840**
